messages.content: I need an offline document index for 200 PDFs. It must stay on one Linux laptop, cost nothing in recurring fees, and preserve source page references.
We can compare a simple local keyword index and a local vector index.
Which would you start with? Give a recommendation in under 150 words.

rubric: Preserves offline and zero recurring fee requirements
